hardware.gpu: 2 x NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti 22 GiB, SM75, NVLink

configuration.warmup: one 512-token decode run per chunk, one prefill run; three formal runs per group

timing.memory_peak: nvidia-smi every two seconds; short peaks may be missed

changes: Q2_0 expert tile vector load and unpack with unchanged MMA accumulation
Quantize gate/up token input once and gather packed activations by route; reuse existing product scratch
Skip inactive workspace rows in gather and down-input quantization
Q2_0 Dense Q8/DP4A MMVQ for 1-8 rows, 64-column alignment and staged Q8 input <=32 KiB

ncu.method: GPU0 isolated operator replay; actual captured expert tensors/routes; actual dense packed weights with synthetic nonzero FP16 inputs; cold cache, kernel replay, clocks uncontrolled
ncu.units: DRAM GB/s is measured hardware traffic, not weight bytes divided by duration; percentages are NCU sustained-peak metrics

fixture_correction.issue: Two-argument ToDevice(CUDA,{0}) selects the bool copyData overload and disables copying. The replay Tensor helper is corrected to ToDevice(CUDA,{0},true).
fixture_correction.affected: Synthetic Dense and HC input/weight replay fixtures only; actual expert snapshots, independent CUDA tests and all full-model measurements use explicit copies or model runtime and are unaffected.

limitations: Dense activation Q8 quantization changes generated tokens; approximately 1% decode difference includes changed routing and clock/timing variation.
Arithmetic/JSON and operator numerical checks do not constitute a model-wide quality or perplexity evaluation.
Performance and sanitizer coverage are on NVIDIA SM75; no cross-architecture performance claim.
Nsight reports driver/tool-version collection warnings; expected per-layer expert and token-marker counts were audited.
